title: Sindh Wild-Life Protection Second Amendment Act 1972

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Wild-Life Protection Second Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1972
ACT XVII OF 1972
SIND WILD-LIFE PROTECTION (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An
Act to amend the Sind Wild-life Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 8th
December 1972]
(First published after having received the
assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated
the 8th December 1972).
No.
PAS/Legis-B-17/72.-The Sind Wild-life Protection (Second Amendment) Bill, 1972
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 17th
day of November 1972 and assented to by the Governor of Sind on the 8th
December 1972 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1)
This Act may be called the Sind Wild-life Protection (Second Amendment) Act,
1972.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

2. Amendment of section 33 of Sind
Ordinance V of 1972.-In the Sind Wild-life Protection Ordinance, 1972, in
section 33, subsection (3), for the words "five hundred", the words
"one thousand and five hundred" shall be substituted.
